verdict.rationale: A feedback loop from analyst decisions into models and rules is a fair question for a compliance and risk platform with case management and AI agents, so the axis applies. The evidence shows analysts can record case decisions (no risk / accepted / offboard), configure the risk-score equation, and rely on AI agents that auto-remediate and escalate. None of it documents analyst decisions or confirmed outcomes being fed back to retrain models or tune rules. Manual risk-score configuration is an adjacent control and earns no credit.
